method: Greedy forward selection at 0.5% risk, then risk (0.25, 0.375, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0) x guards ['none', 'daily-2', 'daily-2-open-3'] on the first 80% of the common 5y window; 2000 calendar-block bootstrap paths, 365-day horizon; frozen choice re-run on the untouched final 20%. Conservative (open risk at stop) – optimistic (closed trades) ranges. The holdout is untouched only for choosing the combination: the EAs' own settings were developed on this history, so neither window is a true out-of-sample test.
